title: TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Charges by Payment Arrangement
content:
The charge of a TRICARE Prime catch-up installment depends on the installment frequency of the enrollment's payment arrangement.

## Clause

1. **Monthly arrangement.** The catch-up charge is the months it bills at the monthly rate, less what TRICARE Select's coverage takes off.
2. **Quarterly arrangement.** It is the quarters from the one containing its first month through the one containing its last month at the quarterly installment, less the installment charges whose coverage begins from the first month of that first quarter through its last month, less what TRICARE Select's coverage takes off and less the months the region bears at the monthly rate.
3. **Otherwise (annual arrangement).** It is the plan year's annual fee less the installment charges on the account whose coverage begins in the current plan year on or before today.

Quarters are calendar quarters: January to March, April to June, July to September and October to December.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

**Monthly.** TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual (monthly rate 32.51); the catch-up bills four months and nothing comes off for TRICARE Select: 4 multiplied by 32.51 is 130.04.

**Quarterly.** TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B, family (quarterly installment 242.34, monthly rate 80.78); the catch-up's first month is May and its last month August, so the quarters are April to June and July to September: 2 multiplied by 242.34 is 484.68. An installment charge of 80.78 begins in April, inside the span from 1 April through August, and comes off; nothing comes off for TRICARE Select and the region bears no month: 484.68 less 80.78 is 403.90.

**Annual.** TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual (annual fee 390.12) with 97.53 of installment charges beginning in the current plan year on or before today: 390.12 less 97.53 is 292.59.
